## Overview

This skill provides guidance on choosing and using testing frameworks effectively.

## Instructions

1. Evaluate framework features against project requirements.
2. Configure CI to run tests on every commit automatically.
3. Write tests before code when practicing TDD rigorously.
4. Use test runners that support parallel execution for speed.
5. Leverage snapshot testing for UI component regression prevention.
6. Mock external dependencies to isolate unit tests properly.
7. Use coverage reports to identify untested code paths systematically.
8. Set meaningful coverage thresholds and enforce them in CI.
9. Write destructive tests that verify failure modes explicitly.
10. Separate setup and teardown logic into dedicated hook functions.
11. Use parameterized tests to reduce duplication across similar cases.
12. Prefer pure functions in tests for deterministic results always.
13. Mock time-dependent behavior using fake timers in tests.
14. Organize test files to mirror the production code structure closely.
15. Document testing conventions in a dedicated README for the team.
